A significant portion of the property buying process also involves legal documentation. A deed of declaration is a legal document that contains relevant information about a property, its ownership, or rights related to it.

At Omshakthy Homes, we think that buyers should be aware of the documents before they finalize a property decision. Whether you're buying a plot or an apartment, being aware of why each document is prepared can save you from confusion later.

What Is a Deed of Declaration?

A deed of declaration is used to declare facts or rights and arrangements in relation to the property. The purpose of the deed depends on the nature of the asset and the relevant law. In an apartment complex, it typically states the property, each unit, shared amenities, and ownership. It defines the ownership and management of different sections of a building.

But a declaration doesn't make you an owner or substitute a registered sale deed.

Why Is a Declaration Deed Important?

The term declaration means a statement condensing the details of the condition of your property. This can be particularly helpful in residential developments when several owners share facilities.

Principal Benefits

  • Property Details: Relevant data of the structure, land and apartments are maintained.
  • Common Ownership: Identifies the rights to use common areas.
  • Increased Transparency: Helps buyers to know the conditions that apply to a property.
  • Reducing Confusion: Provides a resource for inquiries about everyday items or ownership.

What Is the Purpose of the Deed of Declaration?

A declaration is a written expression of a settled agreement as to ownership. This is frequently helpful when multiple owners share facilities in a community of homes.

The Key Advantages

  • Correct Property Information: Provides relevant information about the building, land and units.
  • Shared Ownership: Description of the shared spaces and rights of access.
  • Increased Transparency: Gives buyers a better understanding of the structural environment that properties are operating within.
  • Less Confusion: It is something to refer to in case of questions about shared equipment or ownership interests.

What Does a Declaration Deed Include?

The contents vary with the property and the use of the document. A scaled-down version of the declaration deed format for an apartment complex is as follows:

  • Name and particulars of the promoter or declarants
  • Address of the property and particulars of the land
  • Details about the building and the flat
  • Sanctioned plans and permissions
  • Details of the common areas and other shared facilities
  • Extent of ownership interests in the property and the application of those interests
  • Documents and signatures required for support

For a housing scheme, the owners can work out their individual share of spaces and common utilities with this information.

Types of Property Declarations

Different property arrangements may require different declarations.

  • Declaration of Property Ownership: A deed of declaration for property may state facts or agreements concerning ownership of land or of an interest in land or of any other property. The legal effect is determined by the contents of the document and the applicable law.
  • Builder's Declaration: For apartment developments, a deed of declaration by the builder is especially relevant. Under the apartment ownership regime in Tamil Nadu, the promoter or such required majority of apartment owners shall make the prescribed declaration to the appropriate authority as the case may be.
  • Apartment Declaration: An apartment declaration contains information about the unit, the common areas, amenities, and the interests related to the community. It informs the owner of what they are entitled to and what they must do as a member of the estate.

How to Register a Deed of Declaration in Tamil Nadu

Depending on the type of document, the process of registration varies. For apartment complexes governed by the existing apartment ownership act of Tamil Nadu, the requisite declaration is required to be filed with the competent authority.

Here is how the process generally works:

  • Step 1: Gather the Documents. Have your property information, the approved plans, your proof of ownership and any other required documentation to hand.
  • Step 2: Give Complete Details. Provide correct information about your property in the application form. You may also upload any documents that will help in getting the application approved.
  • Step 3: Deposit Form A. Pay the required fee and hand over Form A to the relevant officer.
  • Step 4: Complete Verification. The application will be processed by the authority and may be subject to corrections or requests for additional information.
  • Step 5: Obtain Acceptance. Once the declaration is accepted, the authority will endorse it and retain a copy.
  • Step 6: Registration. Complete the registration formalities and hold on to the received papers.

Sanction from the appropriate authority is an essential aspect under the Tamil Nadu Apartment Ownership Rules, 2024.

Where Can You Find a Declaration Deed Sample?

If you want a deed of declaration sample, get the government form first instead of an unofficial form or template. For apartment complexes in the state of Tamil Nadu, Form A under the 2024 rules is the prescribed format, along with the necessary details and annexures. The deed of declaration apartment ownership format should be a true reflection of the actual approved plans of the project and the common amenities.

For a deed of declaration download, refer to the official Tamil Nadu Apartment Ownership Rules, 2024, which include the prescribed form.

A downloaded template should never be used without checking whether it applies to your particular property.

What Is the Legal Importance of Registration?

A registered deed of declaration is evidence of the provisions contained in the document. For flat projects, the prescribed filing and registration procedure aids in creating the appropriate ownership and management regime. However, registration will not automatically rectify erroneous details of a property nor resolve a dispute regarding its ownership. Buyers should also check the sale deed, title records, encumbrance records, approved plan and other documents related to the flat before purchase.

Common Mistakes to Avoid

When examining a declaration deed property document, focus on the details and not just the title of the document.

Some typical mistakes are:

  • Using the wrong or expired template.
  • Giving incorrect survey numbers or dimensions of properties.
  • Not accounting for communal facilities and shared ownership.
  • Failure to submit the obligatory supporting documents.
  • Believing that the declaration substitutes proof of ownership.
  • Failing to comply with correction requests from the competent authority.

A specialized conveyancing solicitor will be able to help you identify anything that is missing, and advise you on which legal requirements, if any, are relevant.

How OmShakthy Homes Helps You Buy the Right Property

Proper property paperwork can ease the buying process, whether you're looking for plots in Chennai or need to buy a flat. Land purchasers in Chennai should verify ownership documents, layout sanction, survey documents and all such related papers. Whether you are looking for land for future construction or an immediate purchase, the same declaration and title checks apply before you commit. That same set of checks is not required for every real estate sale, but reviewing the vital paperwork for your purchase can save you a lot of time.

What Do You Need to Check Before Moving On?

Before signing any property document, be sure you know what it is and what rights it gives you. Cross-check it with the supporting documents and confirm that clearance has been received.

At Omshakthy Homes, we recommend our buyers read their paperwork carefully and seek professional advice if needed. Having knowledge of these documents allows you to make a better decision and proceed with more confidence.
